subject: Junior Project Coordinator application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Legeneering team,

I'm applying for the Junior Structural Project Coordinator role at Henderson advertised on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, where I tracked procurement and materials, kept material records and progress reports, and coordinated engineers, subcontractors and suppliers. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Perth.

The procurement, material management and documentation side of the role is the work I did on site. I haven't worked in fabrication, heavy industry or oil and gas yet.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

subject: Junior Draftsperson / Estimator application, Marc Darenz Masarate

Hi Dynamic Steelform,

I'm applying for the Junior Draftsperson / Estimator role in Forrestdale advertised on SEEK.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D for road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design, and put together cost estimates and bills of quantities. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, reading structural and architectural drawings, tracking materials and writing progress reports. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Perth.

Your advert welcomes people who have recently finished their studies, and learning steel framing from drawing to factory is the kind of start I want. My drafting and estimating so far is coursework, not paid work.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
